scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @sketch-arena/server" "npm run dev -w @sketch-arena/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sketch-arena/protocol && npm run build -w @sketch-arena/server && npm run build -w @sketch-arena/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sketch-arena/protocol && npm run test -w @sketch-arena/server && npm run test -w @sketch-arena/web
scripts.qa:load: npm run build -w @sketch-arena/protocol && npm run build -w @sketch-arena/server && node scripts/load-test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run ops:test
